items.exampleEn: This park was created for the conservation of rare birds.
items.exampleZh: 這座公園是為了保育稀有鳥類而設立的。

items.exampleEn: Too many tourists can cause ecological problems.
items.exampleZh: 太多遊客可能造成生態問題。

items.exampleEn: The new road changed the ecosystem of the valley.
items.exampleZh: 新道路改變了山谷的生態系統。

items.exampleEn: It is warm inside the greenhouse even in January.
items.exampleZh: 即使在一月，溫室裡也很溫暖。

items.exampleEn: The city spends money on the preservation of old buildings.
items.exampleZh: 市政府花錢維護老建築。

items.exampleEn: The environmentalist spoke about saving the forest.
items.exampleZh: 那位環保人士談到如何拯救森林。
回收紙張有助於減少垃圾。

items.exampleEn: She wrote a book on the ecology of rivers.
items.exampleZh: 她寫了一本關於河流生態的書。

items.sentenceEn: Every animal plays a part in the ecosystem.
items.sentenceZh: 每種動物在生態系統裡都扮演一個角色。

items.audioEn: Please put plastic bottles in the blue box; the recycling truck comes on Thursday.
items.audioZh: 請把塑膠瓶放進藍色箱子；回收車星期四會來。

items.sentenceZh: 很多人支持野生動物保育。

items.sentenceEn: My sister wants to be an environmentalist.
items.sentenceZh: 我姊姊想成為環保人士。

items.stemEn: Tomatoes grow well in a warm ____.
items.stemZh: 番茄在溫暖的溫室裡長得很好。

items.stemEn: In ____ class, we learn how plants and animals depend on each other.
items.stemZh: 在生態學課上，我們學習動植物如何互相依賴。

items.passageEn: My aunt is an environmentalist who works for a conservation group. Her team protects a lake near our city. The lake has a healthy ecosystem: fish, birds, insects, and tiny organisms all depend on each other. Last year, the group built a small greenhouse to grow local plants, and later they planted them around the lake. My aunt says the preservation of the lake is important because of its ecological value. She also started a recycling program at her office. Thanks to her, I became interested in ecology, and now I want to study it at university.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨是一位環保人士，在一個保育團體工作。她的團隊保護我們城市附近的一座湖。這座湖有健康的生態系統：魚、鳥、昆蟲和微小的生物都互相依賴。去年，這個團體蓋了一間小溫室來種本地植物，之後再把它們種到湖邊。阿姨說保護這座湖很重要，因為它有生態價值。她也在辦公室推動了一個回收計畫。因為她，我開始對生態學感興趣，現在我想在大學讀這個科目。

questions.questionZh: 那個團體蓋溫室做什麼？

options: 在辦公室推動回收計畫

referenceEn: The recycling area of this building is in the basement.
This building's recycling area is in the basement.
rubricZh: 用 recycling 表示「資源回收」（例如 the recycling area）
